Messages.Author: Klaital
Messages.Body: Cards that require a baron count as cards that require an anarch, right? Since barons have to be anarchs. I seem to recall a ruling along those lines from LSJ after TR came out, but wanting to check to be sure. This matters for at least CrimethInc and Garibaldi-Meucci Museum.

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
> henrik wrote:
> Yes.
> groups.google.com/group/rec.games.trading-cards.jyhad/msg/9e80e76544131d75
>
Correct.

(For those who like Vidal Jarbeaux, using "Requires a Baron" does't use "Requires an Anarch" nor "Requires an Independent vampire" for his special ability -  [LSJ 20081024] )
